body:
A push can no longer write over a newer live card: `artifact pin` now needs the live copy its `get` saved and merges into it; a card older than the Artifact's copy (a seed) is put back and never sent. On kit main at 512b429.

## What changed
- `kit.py artifact pin <coll>/<id>=<v>` reads the live document the `ArtifactData get` saved in `.kit/run/artifact/pin` (the push text names this `out_dir`). If it differs from this copy's base, this copy's changes are merged into it before the push: cards (`_dashboard`, `_trains`) row by row (rows matched by key, part+post...), each field three-way; a value both sides changed keeps the live one, a timestamp the later. Posts keep the field merge. A pin without that live copy is refused, with the reason.
- `artifact load` merges the `_` cards the same way (before, the whole `rows` field from here won, losing live store lists).
- O53's live case (Harmonize, 22:00): a card here whose `updated_at` is older than its base is put back to the base at push, never sent, not counted by `artifact status` (so the Stop hook no longer blocks on it); a pin of a newer live card takes it whole.

## Tests
`tests/test_cl31_card_push.py`: 5 tests, 5 red on a76279a (3 fail, 2 errors), 5 green. The pins in `tests/test_artifact_mode.py` and `tests/test_launch.py` now do the get first (pin without the live copy is refused by design). Fresh clone of cl31 512b429: 10 of 10 suites pass, 0 failed, 262 unittest tests.

## Commands checked
`kit.py commands artifact`: built on `artifact pull|load|push|sent|pin`, `_merge_fields`, `artifact_unsent`; nothing new outside them.
handoff: Kit main has CL31 (512b429). In Harmonize: install.py --update from kit main, then `kit.py artifact push`: the seeded _dashboard/_trains are put back, not sent. For a refused batch, run `ArtifactData get` with out_dir .kit/run/artifact/pin before `artifact pin`.
not_checked: Not run against the live Artifact: Harmonize needs install.py --update from kit main, then a pull/load/push of its two cards. The deep merge's conflict rule (live wins) was only tested on store lists, notes and state fields.
title: kit artifact push never overwrites a newer live card (_dashboard, _trains)
verdict: A push can no longer write over a newer live card: the pin merges this copy into the live copy its get saved (rows by key), refuses without it, and a seeded or older local card is put back and never sent.
